name: Floortris Studio 01
notes: Six generated concept finishes. Not real product SKUs. Original PNGs are retained; optimized WebP files are used in the app. 3D uses mirrored repeats with physical repeat dimensions. Generated borders may not be mathematically seamless. Finishes never alter layout or validation flags.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one-repeat square material texture for a 3D room planner, 1024x1024. Generate ONE flat orthographic, edge-to-edge surface swatch, no room mockup, no perspective, no frame, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no objects, no lighting gradient or cast shadows. Even neutral illumination, restrained premium home-interior finish. Make opposite edges tile seamlessly, with continuous pattern and uniform detail across the full image. Wallpaper: graceful small sage-green fern and eucalyptus sprigs arranged in a balanced scattered repeating print on warm ivory paper. Delicate hand-painted matte shapes in muted sage and olive, fine pale stems, ample ivory breathing room. Natural botanical print, no flowers, no dark background. Pattern repeat represents 60 x 60 cm.
